title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature will provide detailed logging of incoming requests, including error handling for improved debugging and issue tracking. It will also include configurable log levels and output options. This feature is essential for production environments where monitoring and troubleshooting are critical
acceptance: The feature is accepted when logs are correctly generated for different request scenarios, including errors, and log levels can be configured without issues
reason: Improved debugging and issue tracking capabilities are crucial for a production-ready framework like Yantraverse
